name: Oc van
summary: Ốc vặn, also written ốc tực, is a Nguồn dish Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park lists with ốc núi and cơm pồi. The park says Nguồn people live mainly in Minh Hóa.
origin: Nguồn cooking in Minh Hóa, in the Phong Nha-Ke Bang culture note.
howToEat: The park names the snail and does not describe a pot.
A method, a door, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Minh Hóa, where the park places Nguồn communities. A shop address is Check on arrival.
